docstring:
**Finite-target case.** When all $\kappa_\alpha$ are finite, $\kappa_\alpha + 1$
is the ordinary natural-number successor. Special case of `erdos_1167`.
type_pretty:
∀ (r : ℕ),
  2 ≤ r →
    ∀ (lam : Cardinal.{u}),
      Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ lam →
        ∀ (γ : Ordinal.{u}),
          2 ≤ γ →
            ∀ (n : γ.ToType → ℕ),
              (Combinatorics.cardinalPartitionRel (2 ^ lam) (r + 1) γ fun α => ↑(n α) + 1) →
                Combinatorics.cardinalPartitionRel lam r γ fun α => ↑(n α)
